newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Pro-Russian Crimea to return to Ukrainian time.
newsitem.headline: Pro-Russian Crimea to return to Ukrainian time.

text.p: Ukraine's pro-Russian Crimean peninsula will switch to Kiev time this weekend after three years of sticking to Moscow time, a local official said on Saturday.
Ukraine's autonomous region of Crimea, two-thirds of its 2.7 million population Russians, introduced Moscow time three years ago as a token of its opposition to Kiev rule.
But Ukraine has managed to reduce the influence of pro-Russian forces in the Crimea in the past two years. Last month the local parliament named a pro-Ukrainian politician as the region's new leader.
